description: HOH, one child under 17 without a valid SSN — § 24(h)(4)(C) treats the child as an other dependent instead of denying the credit.
derivation: Schedule 8812 lines 4–7: no qualifying-child SSN so line 4 = 0 and line 5 = $0; the same child is the one other dependent on line 6, so line 7 = $500. Taxpayer has a valid SSN. MAGI $60,000 is below the $200,000 other-status phase-out, so lines 10–11 are $0 and line 12 = $500. Tax on HOH $36,375 covers the $500 ODC on Form 1040 line 19.
